title: Evaluation convention changes the observed gap
body: On LIBERO-90 task 28, the October 28 report records a 24-point sparse–Robometer gap under deterministic evaluation and an 8-point gap in a separate stochastic reevaluation. Match the sampler before interpreting reward effects.

title: Match the optimization protocol
body: The implementation audit documents differences in actor update frequency, warm-up units, chunk discount, and evaluation versus the reference π₀/LIBERO DSRL setup. A controlled follow-up should match these before attributing degradation to reward error.

title: Early peaks do not establish stable improvement
body: The October 28 report shows substantial early gains followed by collapse in several four-environment runs. Inspect the full curve alongside the latest checkpoint; longer training alone is not established as a remedy.
